$description: Transition fx climax overrides. Adapter looks up in priority order: byCatalogId → byLowLevel → defaultClimaxForTag heuristic. `byCatalogId` carries the 5 hand-tuned per-sample climax values that map cleanly from legacy `casperaki1/api/v1.0/services/data/sounds/fx/effectsMetadata.json` to today's xlsx catalog rows. `byLowLevel` carries family-wide conventions recovered from legacy (see 58e audit) — values that Stefan applied uniformly across all rows of a particular lowLevel rather than per-sample. The remaining 44 explicit-climax legacy entries reference Serum FX and Type1/2/3 tonalReverse packs that aren't in the disk library — unreachable. See docs/58d-climax-overrides.md + docs/58e-unified-catalog.md.

fxTonalReverse.rationale: Legacy Type1/2/3 tonalReverse pack (36 entries × 3 packs × 12 keys) all carried climax=1.1 — a family-wide convention rather than per-sample tuning. Applied here to all 120 fxTonalReverse catalog rows (bigZ Reverses_1..10 × 12 keys) as the lowLevel default.
